settings.on_the_3d_world_gets_in: ON: THE 3D WORLD GETS IN-BETWEEN FRAMES AND MOVES AT 60 FRAMES A SECOND (THE GAMES DRAW IT AT 30). OFF: 30 AS ON A DS.
settings.merged_the_one_widescreen_pictu: MERGED: THE ONE WIDESCREEN PICTURE. THE OTHERS SHOW THE TWO DS SCREENS LAID OUT AS ON OTHER EMULATORS.
settings.for_the_layouts_with_a_large: FOR THE LAYOUTS WITH A LARGE AND A SMALL SCREEN: WHICH ONE IS LARGE. AUTO FOLLOWS WHAT THE GAME IS DOING.
settings.on_fills_your_screen_as_a: ON: FILLS YOUR SCREEN AS A BORDERLESS WINDOW AT ITS OWN RESOLUTION. SWITCHING TO OTHER WINDOWS IS INSTANT. F11 DOES THE SAME.
settings.on_the_picture_is_softened_as: ON: THE PICTURE IS SOFTENED AS IT IS SCALED UP TO YOUR SCREEN. OFF: SHARP PIXELS.
settings.on_the_3d_world_is_drawn: ON: THE 3D WORLD IS DRAWN OUT TO THE SIDES OF THE 16:9 SCREEN. OFF: ONLY AS WIDE AS A DS SCREEN.
settings.black_white_black_2_white_2: BLACK / WHITE / BLACK 2 / WHITE 2: LOADS MORE OF THE MAP AROUND YOU SO THE WIDE VIEW HAS LAND AT ITS EDGES.
settings.where_the_battle_menu_goes_corn: WHERE THE BATTLE MENU GOES. CORNER: SMALL BUTTONS IN A CORNER. PANEL: THE FIGHT / BAG / POKEMON / RUN PANEL FROM THE GAME BESIDE THE BATTLE. STRIP: LARGE BUTTONS IN THE MESSAGE BOX IN BLACK AND WHITE (CORNER IN THE OTHERS). SOULSILVER / HEARTGOLD / PLATINUM HAVE THEIR OWN.
settings.how_many_lines_the_wide_3d: HOW MANY LINES THE WIDE 3D WORLD IS DRAWN WITH. 720 IS FULL SHARPNESS ON THE SWITCH. LOWER IS LIGHTER ON THE CONSOLE.
settings.on_drops_the_world_detail_for: ON: DROPS THE WORLD DETAIL FOR A MOMENT WHEN DRAWING CANNOT KEEP UP (A MOVE FULL OF EFFECTS) INSTEAD OF SLOWING THE GAME DOWN.
settings.how_sharp_the_3d_world_is: HOW SHARP THE 3D WORLD IS. 720P SUITS MOST PHONES. LOWER IF YOURS CANNOT KEEP UP OR TO SAVE BATTERY. SPRITES AND TEXT KEEP THEIR DS PIXELS.
settings.on_drops_the_3d_resolution_for: ON: DROPS THE 3D RESOLUTION FOR A MOMENT WHEN THE PHONE CANNOT KEEP UP (A MOVE FULL OF EFFECTS) INSTEAD OF SLOWING THE GAME DOWN.
settings.how_sharp_the_3d_world_is_2: HOW SHARP THE 3D WORLD IS. PICK YOUR SCREEN RESOLUTION OR LOWER IF YOUR PC CANNOT KEEP UP. SPRITES AND TEXT KEEP THEIR DS PIXELS.
settings.on_drops_the_3d_resolution_for_: ON: DROPS THE 3D RESOLUTION FOR A MOMENT WHEN YOUR PC CANNOT KEEP UP (A MOVE FULL OF EFFECTS) INSTEAD OF SLOWING THE GAME DOWN.
settings.on_the_3d_world_drops_to: ON: THE 3D WORLD DROPS TO 360P WHILE YOU FAST FORWARD FOR MORE FPS (A FASTER FAST FORWARD IF YOUR PC CANNOT KEEP UP). OFF: YOUR 3D RESOLUTION STAYS.
settings.on_the_wide_3d_world_is: ON: THE WIDE 3D WORLD IS DRAWN BY YOUR GRAPHICS CARD (OPENGL 4.3). TURN IT OFF IF THE WORLD LOOKS WRONG OR THE GAME WILL NOT START: THE PROCESSOR THEN DRAWS IT (THAT WANTS A FAST PC).
settings.the_language_of_the_menus_and: THE LANGUAGE OF THE MENUS AND THIS LIST. AUTO FOLLOWS YOUR DEVICE (ENGLISH WHEN THERE IS NO TRANSLATION FOR IT). THE GAMES KEEP THEIR OWN LANGUAGE.
settings.the_game_s_sound_and_music: THE GAME'S SOUND AND MUSIC. OFF FOR NONE. ALSO IN THE PAUSE MENU WHILE YOU PLAY.
settings.pause_menu_opens_the_pause_menu: PAUSE MENU: + OPENS THE PAUSE MENU WHILE PLAYING. DS START: + IS THE DS START BUTTON (THE GAMES HARDLY USE IT) AND + AND - TOGETHER OPEN THE MENU.
settings.pause_menu_start_on_a_controlle: PAUSE MENU: START ON A CONTROLLER OPENS THE PAUSE MENU WHILE PLAYING. DS START: IT IS THE DS START BUTTON (THE GAMES HARDLY USE IT). THE START ON THE SCREEN IS ALWAYS THE DS START.
PAUSE MENU: START ON A CONTROLLER (MENU ON XBOX / OPTIONS ON PS) OPENS THE PAUSE MENU WHILE PLAYING. DS START: IT IS THE DS START BUTTON (THE GAMES HARDLY USE IT). ENTER IS ALWAYS THE DS START.
settings.by_label_the_button_marked_a: BY LABEL: THE BUTTON MARKED A IS THE DS A ON ANY CONTROLLER. BY POSITION: THE BUTTONS WHERE A DS HAS THEM (XBOX A IS DS B).
settings.on_the_right_stick_moves_a: ON: THE RIGHT STICK MOVES A CURSOR ON THE TOUCH SCREEN AND THE LEFT TRIGGER PRESSES IT.
settings.puts_a_shortcut_for_each_game: PUTS A SHORTCUT FOR EACH GAME IN THIS LIST ON YOUR DESKTOP WITH ITS PICTURE. IT STARTS THAT GAME STRAIGHT AWAY (QUIT IN THE PAUSE MENU STILL COMES BACK TO THIS LIST). CREATE AGAIN AFTER ADDING GAMES OR MOVING THIS FOLDER.
settings.puts_a_shortcut_for_each_game_2: PUTS A SHORTCUT FOR EACH GAME IN THIS LIST ON YOUR DESKTOP AND IN YOUR APPS MENU WITH ITS PICTURE. IT STARTS THAT GAME STRAIGHT AWAY. ON THE STEAM DECK THEY ALSO SHOW UP IN ADD A NON-STEAM GAME. CREATE AGAIN AFTER ADDING GAMES OR MOVING THIS FOLDER.
settings.puts_an_icon_for_each_game: PUTS AN ICON FOR EACH GAME IN THIS LIST ON THE HOME MENU WITH ITS PICTURE. IT STARTS THAT GAME STRAIGHT AWAY. MADE ON THIS CONSOLE: NO PC OR KEYS FILE NEEDED. LIKE ANY FORWARDER THE ICONS NEED SIGPATCHES TO START. INSTALL AGAIN AFTER ADDING GAMES. REMOVE ONE IN THE HOME MENU (OPTIONS / DELETE SOFTWARE).
settings.the_game_list_s_colour_its: THE GAME LIST'S COLOUR: ITS LINES, THE FRAME ROUND THE CHOSEN GAME AND THE TABS.
settings.your_picture_put_a_picture_name: YOUR PICTURE: PUT A PICTURE NAMED BACKGROUND.JPG OR BACKGROUND.PNG IN /SWITCH/POKEMON-DS-WIDE/ (WITH YOUR SAVES). BEST AT 1280 X 720 OR 1920 X 1080 (16:9); ANY SIZE WORKS, CUT TO FILL THE SCREEN. IT IS SHOWN DARKENED BEHIND THE GAMES.
YOUR PICTURE: PUT A PICTURE NAMED BACKGROUND.JPG OR BACKGROUND.PNG BESIDE YOUR SAVES FOLDER. BEST AT 1920 X 1080 (16:9); ANY SIZE WORKS, CUT TO FILL THE SCREEN. IT IS SHOWN DARKENED BEHIND THE GAMES.
settings.on_your_retroachievements_accou: ON: YOUR RETROACHIEVEMENTS ACCOUNT FOLLOWS THE GAMES YOU PLAY AND UNLOCKS POP UP AS YOU PLAY (CASUAL MODE: SAVE STATES AND FAST FORWARD STILL WORK; PAUSED WHILE A CHEAT IS ON).
settings.log_in_with_your_retroachieveme: LOG IN WITH YOUR RETROACHIEVEMENTS USER NAME AND PASSWORD (A FREE ACCOUNT FROM RETROACHIEVEMENTS.ORG). THE PASSWORD IS SENT ONCE AND NOT KEPT. CHOSEN AGAIN WHEN LOGGED IN: LOG OUT.
settings.press_while_playing_and_togethe: PRESS + WHILE PLAYING (+ AND - TOGETHER WITH START BUTTON ON DS START). EVERYTHING ABOVE IS THERE TOO AND CAN BE CHANGED AS YOU PLAY.
settings.hold_zr_up_to_4x_fast: HOLD ZR (UP TO 4X). FAST FORWARD IN THE PAUSE MENU KEEPS IT ON WITHOUT HOLDING.
settings.the_menu_button_at_the_top: THE MENU BUTTON AT THE TOP OF THE SCREEN WHILE PLAYING OR START OR GUIDE ON A CONTROLLER. EVERYTHING ABOVE IS THERE TOO.
settings.hold_the_button_beside_r_at: HOLD THE >> BUTTON BESIDE R AT THE TOP, OR THE RIGHT TRIGGER OF A CONTROLLER (UP TO 4X). FAST FORWARD IN THE PAUSE MENU KEEPS IT ON WITHOUT HOLDING.
settings.esc_on_the_keyboard_on_a: ESC ON THE KEYBOARD. ON A CONTROLLER: START (MENU ON XBOX / OPTIONS ON PS) OR ITS GUIDE BUTTON. EVERYTHING ABOVE IS THERE TOO.
settings.hold_the_right_trigger_or_left: HOLD THE RIGHT TRIGGER OR LEFT SHIFT (UP TO 4X). FAST FORWARD IN THE PAUSE MENU KEEPS IT ON WITHOUT HOLDING.
settings.give_any_ds_button_the_pause: GIVE ANY DS BUTTON / THE PAUSE MENU / FAST FORWARD / SWAP SCREENS ANOTHER BUTTON (ANY CONTROLLER: PRO / JOY-CON OR ONE ADDED WITH SYS-CON OR MISSIONCONTROL). GIVING ONE A BUTTON ANOTHER ONE HAD SWAPS THE TWO. ALSO IN THE PAUSE MENU (CONTROLS). THIS LIST FOLLOWS THE ONES YOU CHANGE.
settings.give_any_ds_button_the_pause_2: GIVE ANY DS BUTTON / THE PAUSE MENU / FAST FORWARD / SWAP SCREENS ANOTHER KEY OR CONTROLLER BUTTON. GIVING ONE A KEY OR BUTTON ANOTHER ONE HAD SWAPS THE TWO. ALSO IN THE PAUSE MENU (CONTROLS). THIS LIST FOLLOWS THE ONES YOU CHANGE (A PLAYS / B GOES BACK / Y OPENS THESE SETTINGS).
settings.in_the_pause_menu_one_quick: IN THE PAUSE MENU: ONE QUICK SLOT PER GAME. YOUR SAVE IN THE GAME IS SEPARATE AND STILL WORKS AS NORMAL.
settings.in_the_pause_menu_start_the: IN THE PAUSE MENU: START THE GAME AGAIN FROM ITS TITLE SCREEN / BACK TO THIS GAME LIST.
settings.shows_the_frames_a_second_in: SHOWS THE FRAMES A SECOND IN A CORNER.
